title: Silver Saver Account: Maximizing Your Interest Earnings
summary: Explains how interest is credited on the Silver Saver Account: interest is credited monthly and, when your balance is below the threshold, earnings reflect 2.5%. Provides strategies to maximize accrued interest (deposit for the full monthly cycle, schedule inflows early, avoid mid-cycle large outflows) and advises reviewing posted interest after each monthly cycle to adjust cash management.
faqs: How often is interest credited on my Silver Saver Account?
What interest rate applies when my balance is below the threshold?
How can I maximize interest by timing deposits during the monthly cycle?
Should I avoid withdrawals mid-cycle to preserve a higher eligible balance?
When should I review posted interest, and what should I do afterward?
